contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Data Transfer Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Data transfer

actions.description: It will ensure devices are correctly positioned

steps: If you are using a wireless transfer, place the devices within 4 inches of each other.
If you are using a wired transfer, plug one end of the USB cable into the charging port of the new phone and connect the other end to the charging port of the old phone.

actions.description: It will move your data between devices

steps: Swipe up on the Home screen to access the Apps screen.
Tap the Search field.
Enter and select Data Transfer to open the app.
Navigate to the TechCorp folder on the Apps screen and open Data Transfer from there.
On the new device, tap Receive on this phone.
On the old device, tap Send from this phone.

actions.description: It will start scanning QR code correctly

steps: On the new device, tap Nexa/Android.
Tap Wireless transfer.
On the old device, tap Wireless data transfer.
Scan QR code displayed on new phone.
